about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Creating opportunities that empower young people and communities.
about.intro: Möjligheternas Plats (Mplats) is a non-profit organization founded in 2013 by passionate community members in Sollentuna. From the very beginning, our mission has been to strengthen opportunities for young people in vulnerable areas, helping them build confidence, skills, and pathways toward long-term engagement in society. With support from partners such as Arvsfonden, we have been able to expand our reach and inspire more youth between the ages of 16–24 to take charge of their future.
about.visionText: We envision a society where every young person, regardless of background, has the chance to grow, lead, and contribute. Through integration, creativity, and community-driven initiatives, we aim to build a stronger, more inclusive future.
about.whatWeDoIntro: Our work is centered around three key areas:
about.researchText: We design and run programs like Dream Academy that encourage leadership, entrepreneurship, and personal growth among young people.
about.appliedText: We collaborate with local and international partners to deliver meaningful activities, from summer programs in Sollentuna to European initiatives like Future Narratives.
about.educationText: We provide workshops, coaching, and outreach that help young people discover their strengths, broaden their networks, and prepare for education or employment.
about.quote: “At Mplats, we believe opportunities are everywhere. Our role is to help young people find them, seize them, and create lasting change.”
about.closing: Our team works passionately for integration and social development. Explore our projects and join us in shaping a future where possibilities are open to all.
